transcript: My friend, I have said this before and I will say it again. Do not let your heart shake when you hear others speak badly of you. People talk about you because when they speak of themselves, no one listens. Do not fear losing people. Fear losing yourself. Let me share a small truth my teacher once told me. The more you try to control something, the more it begins to control you. So release the weight of other people's opinions. Be unique, be memorable, be confident, be proud. But above all, be you. You were never meant to be picked. You were meant to be seen. You were meant to be known. You were meant to be loved simply for your being, not for your performance. And when you finally accept this, a quiet power rises inside you. You stop waiting to be chosen and you begin choosing. Choosing who receives your energy, who receives your softness, who is allowed to remain in your life. And most importantly, my friend, you finally choose yourself. Not because the world called you worthy, but because now you know it.
